description: OnTheMap for Emergency Management is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Census Bureau. This public data tool provides U.S. population and workforce statistics, in real time, for areas being affected by natural disasters. Users can retrieve detailed housing characteristics for areas declared as federal disasters from hurricanes, floods, wildfires, and winter storms. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Cold, Flooding – General, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Vector-Borne Disease, Wildfire. Assets: People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
